note: The main banks: the Channel Islands' banks are largely the offshore arms of UK banks, and a search of their sites and documents (30 October 2026) found no personal credit card that NatWest International, RBS International or Lloyds Bank International offers island residents; Butterfield Bank (Channel Islands), whose credit cards are only for residents of the Channel Islands, Guernsey among them, is the island issuer read. Its credit card fee schedule for personal cards (effective May 2025, the one its site links, read again 30 October 2026), read in full: the Butterfield Standard (no annual fee), Platinum (£50) and World Elite (£195; for holders with £120,000 of income or deposits, a condition the game doesn't check), each at a variable 21.95% on purchases and on cash advances, a cash advance fee of 3% (at least £5), a foreign exchange fee of 2.75% (0.30% on the World Elite), and £12 over-limit, late payment and returned payment fees. The supplementary card fees aren't written; the schedule states no minimum payment, grace period or penalty rate. This file kept the Standard card, read on 29 October 2026, and adds its terms and the other two cards. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): no issuer was added. NatWest International's and RBS International's credit card addresses answered not found, Lloyds Bank International's credit cards page names none, and a search for other Channel Islands card issuers found only Butterfield.
